author: ZelenskyyUa
text:
Russia’s behavior, their choice, is to continue escalating. Russia will continue hybrid attacks against various countries in Europe, not only NATO members. There are hybrid attacks and drone attacks against Moldova, which is not a member of NATO or the European Union, as well as against Germany and Romania.

We have offered our help to various countries, first and foremost to those that are helping us during the war. When we sign a Drone Deal, it is not only about selling drones or missiles. It is also about co-production and sharing experience. And this is an integral part of that exchange of experience.
 
From answers to journalists’ questions. (3/3)
